column12: ASSET-LEVEL ROW. IT IS A VIAL COUNT, NOT A MILLIGRAM COUNT, AND THE VIAL IS WHERE THE UNCERTAINTY IS. Vials are single-dose, so a child is billed for a whole vial whatever the weight-based dose comes to. The protocol's rule 0.07 mg/kg capped at 5 mg means a child needs more than 2.5 mg only above 35.7 kg; USRDS 2025 ADR Table 8.2 puts the US paediatric haemodialysis age split at 0-5 13.3%, 6-12 28.5% and 13-17 58.2% (the split amgn_parsabiv.csv already quotes), so most but not all of the pool is above that weight. Pricing every child at the 2.5 mg vial would give $16,908.84, half this row. Pushing the other way, titration runs to 0.21 mg/kg capped at 15 mg, and a 55 kg adolescent at 0.21 mg/kg needs 11.55 mg, a 10 mg plus a 2.5 mg vial, $541.94 a dose and $84,542 a year. The 5 mg vial is the protocol's own starting cap and sits between those. What would settle it: a weight distribution for US paediatric haemodialysis patients, which USRDS does not publish. column12: ASSET-LEVEL ROW. IT READS HIGH, DELIBERATELY AND BY A KNOWN DIRECTION. Medicaid State Drug Utilization Data reports what states PAID, before the statutory rebate a manufacturer owes Medicaid (a minimum 23.1% of average manufacturer price for a single-source drug), so the manufacturer's realised net is materially below $32.22 a mg and the true deduction is materially above 25.67%. THE ALTERNATIVE PUBLISHED NUMBER IS NOT USABLE AND HERE IS WHY: the only Medicare amount in existence is the ESRD PPS base-rate addition, 'Due to the effect of generic calcimimetics in lowering the drug prices for calcimimetics, $9.93 is the final amount added to the CY 2021 ESRD PPS base rate to account for calcimimetics in the ESRD PPS bundled payment' (CY2021 ESRD PPS final rule, 85 FR, document 2020-24485, published 2020-11-09). That $9.93 is per dialysis treatment, covers etelcalcetide and generic cinacalcet together, and is averaged across every dialysis patient including the majority on no calcimimetic at all. It is not a price for a treated patient on this drug and must not be used as one

BRACKETED BY THE TRIAL DATA, BOTH ABOVE AND BELOW. Below: the pooled 26-week placebo-controlled Phase 3s, FDA Clinical Review for NDA 208325 (CDER, completed 2017-01-30, Reference ID 3974983, Table 3, 'Subject Disposition & Discontinuation Data from Pooled 6-Month Placebo-Controlled Studies 20120229 & 20120230'), etelcalcetide arms: 'Subjects who discontinued investigational product | 40 (15.7) | 42 (16.5) | 82 (16.1)', which annualises to about 29.6% at a constant hazard. Also below: the 52-week open-label extension, Bushinsky DA, Chertow GM, Cheng S et al., Nephrol Dial Transplant 2020;35(10):1769-1778, PMC7538239, '682 (76.5%) completed the 52-week etelcalcetide treatment period. Overall, 207 patients (23.2%) discontinued etelcalcetide' - but that cohort is survivorship-selected, since entry required completing a parent trial, and 50 of the 207 are 'protocol-specified criteria', largely roll-over into a further extension. 27% sits between the two and is the only one of the three measured in routine US care. ONE DIRECTIONAL CAVEAT: the DOPPS window is April 2017 to August 2019, under TDAPA and before calcimimetics entered the ESRD bundle in 2021, an event that cut etelcalcetide use sharply and would push the rate higher after it, so this errs LOW. It is also an ADULT rate applied to a paediatric layer; no paediatric persistence figure exists, and children on chronic haemodialysis leave the modality for transplant, which argues the true paediatric rate is higher still
